why: Reverts the whole fix at its root: _relPageHasOrNeedsColumn() becomes _relPageHasColumn(), which is what 9.99.1086 left the creating sites gated on. A hydrated snapshot with no saved rel cells then never gets the column built, so all three assertions must fail — misaligned rows, no rel cells, no toggle.

why: _initRelationshipsColumnImpl()'s own entry gate is the one that made the call-site fix insufficient: _ensureRelCell() lives inside this function, so bailing here is what left the restored table one column short. Pinned separately from the call site because either alone reproduces the defect.

name: the disk-load call site is back to the DOM answer
why: The Load-from-Disk render tail's own gate — the exact line 442dd8c changed. With the impl's gate still widened this alone is enough to keep initRelationshipsColumn() from ever being called on that path.

name: the header-toggle gate is back to the DOM answer
why: _relInitColHeaderToggles() runs BEFORE initRelationshipsColumn() on the disk tail, so with only this reverted the cells are built but the column has no toggle and no collapsed-filter affordance. This is the half a fix confined to the impl would have missed, and only the third test can see it.
